description:
The `benchbox platforms setup` interactive wizard currently requires users to type
full platform names when selecting actions or platforms. This is error-prone and
tedious, especially with many platforms available.

Replace string-based prompts with numbered list selection for better UX:
- Actions: Show numbered menu (1. Enable, 2. Disable, 3. Install, etc.)
- Platforms: Show numbered list grouped by availability status
- Allow both number and name input for flexibility
